answer: Reversible settlement stops sybil farms. Each reward sits in escrow for a horizon of three epochs, and any agent may file evidence that a payout went to a clone. A proven claim claws the whole reward back, so a farm that slips past the first check loses everything. An honest agent waits out the horizon and keeps its full share. A thousand clones mean an ocean of escrows under watch, and one exposed clone leaves a trail of shared wallets and behaviour, clear as crystal, pointing at the rest, so the farm's expected gain collapses to zero while an honest raven keeps earning.
